.slick-slider {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -moz-user-select: none;
  -ms-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  -khtml-user-select: none;
  -ms-touch-action: pan-y;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.slick-list {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.slick-list:focus {
  outline: none;
}
.slick-list.dragging {
  cursor: pointer;
  cursor: hand;
}
.slick-slider .slick-track,
.slick-slider .slick-list {
  -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -moz-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -ms-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -o-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
}
.slick-track {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  display: block;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.slick-track:before,
.slick-track:after {
  display: table;
  content: '';
}
.slick-track:after {
  clear: both;
}
.slick-loading .slick-track {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-slide {
  display: none;
  float: left;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 1px;
}
[dir='rtl'] .slick-slide {
  float: right;
}
.slick-slide img {
  display: block;
}
.slick-slide.slick-loading img {
  display: none;
}
.slick-slide.dragging img {
  pointer-events: none;
}
.slick-initialized .slick-slide {
  display: block;
}
.slick-loading .slick-slide {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-vertical .slick-slide {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.slick-arrow.slick-hidden {
  display: none;
}

.dmc-pill{
    border: 1px solid green;

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-row {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
            display: none;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-text {
            color: #333;
            margin-left: 5px;
            padding-right: 0;
            padding-top: 5px;

.slick-slider {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -moz-user-select: none;
  -ms-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  -khtml-user-select: none;
  -ms-touch-action: pan-y;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.slick-list {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.slick-list:focus {
  outline: none;
}
.slick-list.dragging {
  cursor: pointer;
  cursor: hand;
}
.slick-slider .slick-track,
.slick-slider .slick-list {
  -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -moz-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -ms-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -o-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
}
.slick-track {
  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  display: block;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.slick-track:before,
.slick-track:after {
  display: table;
  content: '';
}
.slick-track:after {
  clear: both;
}
.slick-loading .slick-track {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-slide {
  display: none;
  float: left;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 1px;
}
[dir='rtl'] .slick-slide {
  float: right;
}
.slick-slide img {
  display: block;
}
.slick-slide.slick-loading img {
  display: none;
}
.slick-slide.dragging img {
  pointer-events: none;
}
.slick-initialized .slick-slide {
  display: block;
}
.slick-loading .slick-slide {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-vertical .slick-slide {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.slick-arrow.slick-hidden {
  display: none;
}

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-row {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
            display: none;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-text {
            color: #333;
            margin-left: 5px;
            padding-right: 0;
            padding-top: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
            padding-left: 0;
            padding-top: 0;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
        width: 30px;
        max-height: 28px;
        display: flex;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon img {
        width: 100%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-text {
        margin-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 5px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        color: #333;
        font-size: 0.688rem;
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal p {
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-group {
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon {
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #fff;
        display: flex;
        position: relative;
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        margin: 0 auto 16px;
        padding: 10px;
        justify-content: center;
        box-shadow: 0 -10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon img {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon:empty {
        display: none;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle {
        display: inline-block;
        font-family: "GothamMedium", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.6;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        padding: 4px 24px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double {
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh:after,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double:after {
        content: "";
        bottom: -21px;
        margin: auto;
        left: -2px;
        background: url(https://mobilecontent.costco.com/staging/resource/img/24w01226/swoosh-small--red.svg) no-repeat;
        position: absolute;
        width: 43px;
        height: 100%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double:after {
        background: url(https://mobilecontent.costco.com/staging/resource/img/24w01226/swoosh-double--red.svg) no-repeat;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
            flex-direction: row;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1100px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 2rem !important;
            text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
        }
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header br {
            display: none;
        }
    }

.slick-slider {

  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

  outline: none;
}
.slick-list.dragging {
  cursor: pointer;
  cursor: hand;
}

  -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

.slick-track:after {
  display: table;
  content: '';
}

  clear: both;

.slick-vertical .slick-slide {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

  display: none;

.dmc-pill{

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-row {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
            display: none;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-text {
            color: #333;
            margin-left: 5px;
            padding-right: 0;
            padding-top: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
            padding-left: 0;

        }

        display: flex;

    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon img {

    }

.slick-slider {

  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.slick-list:focus {
  outline: none;
}
.slick-list.dragging {
  cursor: pointer;
  cursor: hand;
}

}

.dmc-pill{

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;

.dmc-pill{
    border: 1px solid green;

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;

        }

    }

.slick-slider {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -moz-user-select: none;
  -ms-user-select: none;

  -khtml-user-select: none;
  -ms-touch-action: pan-y;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.slick-list {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.slick-list:focus {
  outline: none;
}
.slick-list.dragging {
  cursor: pointer;
  cursor: hand;
}
.slick-slider .slick-track,
.slick-slider .slick-list {
  -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -moz-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -ms-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -o-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

}

  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  display: block;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.slick-track:before,
.slick-track:after {
  display: table;
  content: '';
}
.slick-track:after {
  clear: both;
}
.slick-loading .slick-track {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-slide {
  display: none;
  float: left;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 1px;
}
[dir='rtl'] .slick-slide {
  float: right;
}
.slick-slide img {
  display: block;
}

  display: none;
}
.slick-slide.dragging img {
  pointer-events: none;
}
.slick-initialized .slick-slide {
  display: block;
}
.slick-loading .slick-slide {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-vertical .slick-slide {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.slick-arrow.slick-hidden {
  display: none;
}

.dmc-pill{

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-row {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
            display: none;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-text {
            color: #333;
            margin-left: 5px;
            padding-right: 0;
            padding-top: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
            padding-left: 0;
            padding-top: 0;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
        width: 30px;
        max-height: 28px;
        display: flex;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon img {
        width: 100%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-text {
        margin-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 5px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal {

        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal p {
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-group {
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .product-mid-concierge-espot {display: none;}
    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }
    .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #333;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-row {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
            display: none;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-text {
            color: #333;
            margin-left: 5px;
            padding-right: 0;
            padding-top: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
            padding-left: 0;
            padding-top: 0;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
        width: 30px;
        max-height: 28px;
        display: flex;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon img {
        width: 100%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-text {
        margin-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 5px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        color: #333;
        font-size: 0.688rem;
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal p {
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-group {
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon {
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #fff;
        display: flex;
        position: relative;
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        margin: 0 auto 16px;
        padding: 10px;
        justify-content: center;
        box-shadow: 0 -10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon img {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon:empty {
        display: none;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle {
        display: inline-block;
        font-family: "GothamMedium", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.6;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        padding: 4px 24px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double {
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh:after,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double:after {
        content: "";
        bottom: -21px;
        margin: auto;
        left: -2px;
        background: url(https://mobilecontent.costco.com/staging/resource/img/24w01226/swoosh-small--red.svg) no-repeat;
        position: absolute;
        width: 43px;
        height: 100%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double:after {
        background: url(https://mobilecontent.costco.com/staging/resource/img/24w01226/swoosh-double--red.svg) no-repeat;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
            flex-direction: row;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-header .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-header .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
            font-size: 2rem !important;
            text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
        }
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header br {
            display: none;
        }
    }

.slick-slider {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -moz-user-select: none;
  -ms-user-select: none;

  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.slick-list:focus {
  outline: none;
}
.slick-list.dragging {
  cursor: pointer;
  cursor: hand;
}

.slick-slider .slick-list {
  -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -moz-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

  -o-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  display: block;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.slick-track:before,
.slick-track:after {
  display: table;
  content: '';
}
.slick-track:after {
  clear: both;
}
.slick-loading .slick-track {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-slide {
  display: none;
  float: left;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 1px;
}
[dir='rtl'] .slick-slide {
  float: right;
}
.slick-slide img {
  display: block;
}
.slick-slide.slick-loading img {
  display: none;
}
.slick-slide.dragging img {
  pointer-events: none;
}
.slick-initialized .slick-slide {
  display: block;
}
.slick-loading .slick-slide {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-vertical .slick-slide {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.slick-arrow.slick-hidden {
  display: none;
}

.slick-slider {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -moz-user-select: none;
  -ms-user-select: none;

  -khtml-user-select: none;
  -ms-touch-action: pan-y;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.slick-list {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.slick-list:focus {
  outline: none;
}
.slick-list.dragging {
  cursor: pointer;
  cursor: hand;
}
.slick-slider .slick-track,
.slick-slider .slick-list {
  -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -moz-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -ms-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  -o-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

  position: relative;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  display: block;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.slick-track:before,
.slick-track:after {
  display: table;
  content: '';
}
.slick-track:after {
  clear: both;
}
.slick-loading .slick-track {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-slide {
  display: none;
  float: left;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 1px;
}
[dir='rtl'] .slick-slide {
  float: right;
}
.slick-slide img {
  display: block;
}
.slick-slide.slick-loading img {
  display: none;
}
.slick-slide.dragging img {
  pointer-events: none;
}
.slick-initialized .slick-slide {
  display: block;
}
.slick-loading .slick-slide {
  visibility: hidden;
}
.slick-vertical .slick-slide {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.slick-arrow.slick-hidden {
  display: none;
}

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-row {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
            display: none;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-text {
            color: #333;
            margin-left: 5px;
            padding-right: 0;
            padding-top: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
            padding-left: 0;
            padding-top: 0;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
        width: 30px;
        max-height: 28px;
        display: flex;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon img {
        width: 100%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-text {
        margin-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 5px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        color: #333;
        font-size: 0.688rem;
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal p {
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-group {
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon {
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #fff;
        display: flex;
        position: relative;
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        margin: 0 auto 16px;
        padding: 10px;
        justify-content: center;
        box-shadow: 0 -10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon img {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon:empty {
        display: none;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle {
        display: inline-block;
        font-family: "GothamMedium", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.6;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        padding: 4px 24px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double {
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh:after,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double:after {
        content: "";
        bottom: -21px;
        margin: auto;
        left: -2px;
        background: url(https://mobilecontent.costco.com/staging/resource/img/24w01226/swoosh-small--red.svg) no-repeat;
        position: absolute;
        width: 43px;
        height: 100%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double:after {
        background: url(https://mobilecontent.costco.com/staging/resource/img/24w01226/swoosh-double--red.svg) no-repeat;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
            flex-direction: row;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            margin-bottom: 0;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1100px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 2rem !important;
            text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
        }
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header br {
            display: none;
        }
    }

.eco-citi-samsung-headline {padding:0 .75em .25em .75em;}
.eco-citi-samsung-headline-half {font-size:calc(18px + 0.1vw);padding:.5em .25em .5em .25em;}
}
			
@media only screen and (max-width: 510px) { 
.eco-citi-samsung-headline-half {font-size:calc(13px + 0.1vw);padding:.25em .25em .25em .25em;}
}
	
@media only screen and (max-width: 376px) { 
.eco-citi-samsung-headline-half {font-size:calc(11px + 0.1vw);}
}
	

/* FQ and CATEGORY STYLE */	
.eco-citi-samsung-fq-category {overflow: hidden; margin:0; padding:0;}
.eco-category-child {margin:0 0 -99999px 0;  padding:0 0 99999px 0; }
.eco-citi-samsung-fq {height: 400px; overflow: hidden; margin:0; padding:0;}	
.eco-samsung-logo{margin:0 auto;text-align:center; max-width:18%; padding-top:.25em;}		
.eco-samsung-header{line-height: 1.25em; text-align:left; font-size:24px; padding: .25em 2em 1em 0;}	
.eco-citi-ribbon{text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: bold; background: #d32122; color:#ffffff; padding:2%; margin-top:2%; font-size:17px;}		

@media only screen and (max-width: 1400px) {
.eco-citi-samsung-fq {height: 28vw;}
.eco-samsung-header{font-size:calc(16px + 0.5vw);}
.eco-citi-ribbon{font-size:calc(9px + 0.5vw);}	
}	
			
@media only screen and (max-width: 768px) { 
.eco-citi-samsung-fq {height: 50vw;}	
.eco-citi-ribbon{font-size:calc(12px + 0.5vw); padding:0; margin-top:0; } 
.eco-samsung-header{text-align:center;}
}
	
@media only screen and (max-width: 667px) { 
.eco-samsung-header{font-size:calc(12px + 0.5vw)}
}
	
@media only screen and (max-width: 660px) {	
.eco-citi-samsung-fq {height: 50vw;}
}
	
@media only screen and (max-width: 376px) { 
.eco-citi-ribbon{font-size:calc(10px + 0.5vw);  }	
}

/* BANER STYLE - all */		
.eco-samsung-logo-bn{text-align:center;margin:0 auto; max-width: 130px; }

.eco-citi-samsung-banner { color:#333333; overflow:hidden; padding:1px; }
.eco-citi-spacer{ height:.25em;}

.eco-citi-legal-banner{font-size:calc(7px + 0.5vw);}
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 1200px) {
.eco-citi-spacer{ height:.5em;}	
}
	
@media only screen and (max-width: 1025px) { 		
.eco-samsung-sl-one-banner{text-align:center;}

.eco-samsung-sl-one-banner{padding:0px 10px 0px 10px;}

    .product-mid-concierge-espot {display: none;}
    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }
    .eco-prod-advantage-header-commercial {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #333;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        padding-left: 5px;
        padding-right: 5px
    }

    @media(min-width:1200px) {

        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-container,
        .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        flex: 0 0 50%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 3px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:first-child {
        flex: 0 0 60%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        flex: 0 0 40%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col {
        padding: 5px 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        padding-left: 15px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-full .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
        background-color: #333;
        content: "";
        height: 500%;
        width: 1px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
    }

    @media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
            margin-right: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-row {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child::before {
            display: none;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-text {
            color: #333;
            margin-left: 5px;
            padding-right: 0;
            padding-top: 5px;
        }

        .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-col:last-child {
            padding-left: 0;
            padding-top: 0;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon {
        width: 30px;
        max-height: 28px;
        display: flex;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-icon img {
        width: 100%
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-text {
        margin-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 5px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        color: #333;
        font-size: 0.688rem;
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0 12px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-legal p {
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-col .eco-prod-advantage-legal {
        margin-top: 5px;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-group {
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon {
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #fff;
        display: flex;
        position: relative;
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        margin: 0 auto 16px;
        padding: 10px;
        justify-content: center;
        box-shadow: 0 -10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon img {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-heading-icon:empty {
        display: none;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle {
        display: inline-block;
        font-family: "GothamMedium", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.6;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        padding: 4px 24px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double {
        position: relative;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh:after,
    .eco-prod-advantage-subtitle .eco-prod-swoosh-double:after {
        content: "";
        bottom: -21px;
        margin: auto;
        left: -2px;

.dmc-pill{
    border: 1px solid green;
    background: white !important;

    .eco-prod-advantage {
        color: #333;
        background-color: #eeeeee;
        font-size: .875rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* "-full" = the full sized version of the component */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-full {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* "-mini" = the narrower version of the component that has less content in it */
    .eco-prod-advantage.eco-prod-advantage-mini {
        max-width: 450px;
        width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-bg-color {
        background-color: #005dab;
        color: #fff;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-flex {
            padding: 24px 16px;
        }
    }

    /*-- Copy --*/
    /* aka left side of full version of component */
    .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
        text-align: center;
        width: 80%;
        margin: auto;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) and (max-width:850px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-copy {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    /* header */
    .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        text-align: center;
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 36px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        line-height: 1.3;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    @media(min-width:769px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 24px !important;
        }
    }

    @media(min-width:1025px) {
        .eco-prod-advantage-header {
            font-size: 1.75rem !important;
        }
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-mini .eco-prod-advantage-header {
        color: #ffffff;
        line-height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.125rem !important;
        margin: 12px 12px 5px;
        padding: 8px 5px 8px 1px;
        background-color: #005dab;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* CTA */

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a {
        background-color: #d32029;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        border-radius: 50px;
        margin-top: 8px;
        padding: 8px 30px;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: .1s linear;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:hover,
    .eco-prod-advantage-cta a:focus {
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #333 !important;
        transition: .25s ease-in-out;
        text-decoration: none !important;
    }

    /* List Container */
    .eco-prod-advantage-container {
        overflow: hidden;
        margin: auto 0;
